text:
maria: Thanks for the questions in today's all-hands. I'm threading the finance/procurement follow-ups here so we can track owners and next steps. I'll tag folks and summarize live Qs. Reply with short updates/next steps only please. :sparkles:

sasha: Quick summary from finance — current base-case runway is ~16 months at today's burn. We have mitigations to stretch it without large product cuts. I'll post the model.

jordan: To add detail: base-case assumes 8% QoQ ARR growth. Downside scenario (flat ARR) brings us closer to ~12 months. Primary levers: hiring cadence, Dedicated expansion timing, and a few big vendor commits.

liam: Question — if we pause hires, which roles are absolutely critical for Dedicated delivery to existing customers? Need a list to plan roadmaps.

maria: Good call @liam — eng/product leads: please submit "critical hires" list (title + rationale + earliest start date) by EOD Friday so we can prioritize. cc @sasha.

ingrid: Procurement follow-up from Q: here's the approval flow and checklist we will use going forward. Please read and follow before submitting POs.

ingrid: ```
Approval thresholds & flow:
  <= $25k : manager approval + procurement intake
  $25k - $100k : manager + finance + procurement
  > $100k : manager + finance + procurement + legal + exec sign-off
Required attachments:
  - SOW or quote
  - Security questionnaire (if vendor handles data)
  - Budget code and owner
  - Expected invoice timing
```

anna: Legal note: any vendor with production data access needs an executed DPA + completed security questionnaire before invoices are approved. If you think you have an exception, escalate to me with a clear risk mitigation plan.

samir: What's the fast/emergency path for time-sensitive infra purchases (e.g., failed instance replacement, critical performance fix)?

jordan: Emergency procedure: get verbal ok from finance + procurement (Slack mention is fine), submit PO same day with subject prefix `EMERGENCY - vendor name`, and route retro approvals within 72 hours. We'll treat exceptions conservatively.

sasha: I'll upload the runway sensitivity workbook to /docs/finance/runway-sensitivity.xlsx and share a short README with scenarios and assumptions. Expect that by Monday COB.

maria: Action items from thread:
  1) Eng/Product: critical hires list by EOD Fri (owners: eng/product leads)
  2) Procurement: publish checklist + intake form (owner: @ingrid) by Tue
  3) Finance: share runway sensitivity workbook and assumptions by Mon (owner: @sasha)
  4) Legal: confirm DPA + redline guidance and template location (owner: @anna)
  5) Exec: reconvene cross-functional sync after those artifacts are posted (I'll schedule)

liam: We'll gather hiring list and tag product leads.

ingrid: I'll post the procurement intake form and a short explainer doc tomorrow morning.

anna: DPA template here (internal): https://redwood.internal/legal/dpa-template — ping me for urgent redlines.

deploy-bot: :bell: Reminder: Procurement + finance training session scheduled Wed 10:00 AM in #all-hands (calendar invite sent).

sasha: One more ask from finance — can we run monthly spend reviews for the next 3 months (instead of quarterly) until runway moves back to comfortable territory?

jordan: Agreed. We'll do monthly reviews for the next three cycles and then reassess cadence.

maria: Thanks everyone — this thread will be the single source for follow-ups. If you have updates, post here and tag owners. I'll spin up the cross-functional sync after Tuesday artifacts are live. :white_check_mark:
